card.name: Digits inside numbers in dose tables
card.fires_on: A single digit token that continues or ends a multi-digit or decimal number, such as the 2 in 7.2 or the 4 in 2.4. It appears in dosing tables, ranges and exposure figures.

modes.label: Decimal digit
modes.description: The digit after a decimal point in a table cell or dose value.
modes.example: mg 1.8 mL 1.0 mL 1 g 3.6 mL 2.1 mL 2 g 7.<<2>> mL 4.2 mL Intravenous

modes.label: Digit in whole number
modes.description: The last or middle digit of a larger integer in a dose range or table.

card.plain: It fires on the digits within numbers in dose and exposure tables, not on the words around them.
